title: SkyrimNet Brothel
tagline: Run your own brothel: register workers, send customers to them or take customers yourself, and SkyrimNet's AI voices every offer and answer while SexLab plays the scene.
description:
SkyrimNet Brothel lets you turn any interior into a brothel. You register women as workers (followers or anyone else), and customers walk up to them and make paid offers. SkyrimNet's AI writes and voices each offer and the worker's answer, she can accept or refuse, and SexLab plays the scene on the nearest free bed.

You can also take customers yourself and answer them by picking AI-written lines in the dialogue menu, including which position you want. The choice system is built into the mod, so SkyrimNet Player Choices is no longer needed.

People from the brothel's town can walk over during opening hours and become customers. You can name yourself or an NPC as the owner, who takes a share of every payment, recommends workers to customers and talks to the workers about their takings. Experienced workers invite customers on their own, and the brothel and every worker gain levels from 1 to 10 that change how they feel about the work.

Customers pay up front and get their gold back if the deal falls through. Everything is set up in an MCM with six pages. The mod requires SexLab P+ (SexLab 1.6x is supported but has not been tested in game), MCM Helper, PapyrusUtil and powerofthree's Papyrus Extender. A Japanese translation is available as a separate archive.
author: taka
changelog: 0.1.8: The menu now shows correctly in games set to any language, not only English. 0.1.7: Townsfolk can visit the brothel as customers. You can name an owner who takes a share and runs the brothel. You can work as one of the girls yourself, and experienced workers invite customers on their own. The brothel and every worker gain levels from 1 to 10. Customers pay up front, and the MCM is split into six pages. SkyrimNet Player Choices is now built in and no longer required. Fixes include an MCM crash with Papyrus Tweaks, customers starting fights, stalled scenes and pairs sinking into common beds.
